name: 09_both_fail_resets_count
description: [H1] Magnitude floor fails (price just above the floor) even though the breakdown gate WOULD confirm. The magnitude AND-clause is a hard floor: count resets to 0; hit=False.
derivation: Guard passes. Magnitude: -1.05 <= -1.0 - 0.10 = -1.10 is FALSE (-1.05 > -1.10). [H1 GATE] Breakdown: prob_underperforming 70.0 >= MC_BREAKDOWN_THRESHOLD(60.0) is TRUE (mc WOULD confirm). Combined `mag AND mc_breakdown_ok` = False AND True = False. Condition fails on the magnitude floor -> reset branch. new_count = 0; hit = False. Count was 2 in; the else-branch unconditionally sets below_stop_count = 0 (no decrement). Pins that the magnitude floor is a hard AND-clause: a confirmed breakdown alone cannot fire the stop without the price actually breaching the floor.
